a: A bot is a helper that works for you. You tell it what you want in plain words, and it reads, searches, writes or clicks to get it done. You can have several bots, each for a different job.

Your chats, files and settings stay on this computer. Only what the bot needs to answer is sent to the AI service you chose. Pick a model that runs on this computer and nothing leaves it. Praxi-Bot does not collect usage data.

q: How do I stop a bot right now?
a: Press the red Stop button, or the stop shortcut shown in Keyboard shortcuts. Everything running stops at once. Your bots and chats stay safe.

Praxi-Bot is free. The AI service you connect may charge for what you use. Google Gemini has a free plan, and models that run on this computer are free. You can set a monthly limit on the Usage page so you never pay more than you decide.

q: What is a model, and do I need a key?
a: A model is the AI that does the thinking for your bot. Most models need a key, which is like a password that lets Praxi-Bot use your account. The easiest start is a free Google Gemini key. Settings → AI shows how to get one.

q: How do I get a free key?
a: Open the setup, choose Google Gemini and press “Get my key”. Sign in with a Google account, press “Create API key”, copy it and paste it into Praxi-Bot. It checks the key right away and tells you if something is wrong.

q: Will the bot do things without asking me?
a: Only as much as you allow. At the safest level it asks before it changes or sends anything. Payments always need your OK, whatever you pick. You can set a different level for each bot.

q: Can a bot delete my files?
a: Only if you allow it. By default a bot asks before it deletes or edits a file, and it can only touch the folders you share with it. You see what it wants to do and decide.

q: How do I add apps like Gmail or Calendar?
a: Open Apps from the menu, find the app and press Connect. A web page opens where you sign in to that service. Praxi-Bot never sees your password. Then choose which bots may use the app.

q: What is a server, and do I need one?
a: A server is another computer that stays on all the time, for example one you rent. Bots there keep working when your own computer is off. You do not need one. By default your bots run on this computer.
On this computer, while Praxi-Bot is open. They use your files only in the folders you share. If you later add a server, you can choose to run a bot there instead.

q: How do I make a bot do something every day?
a: Open Schedules, press the plus button, choose the bot, write what it should do and pick the time. It runs by itself at that time, as long as the computer is on.
Yes, it can remember useful facts such as your name or how you like things done. You can read, edit or delete every memory in Settings → Memory.

q: The bot does not answer. What now?
a: First check that a model is connected in Settings → AI. Then check your internet connection and try again. If you see a message with “Details”, it explains what happened. If it keeps failing, restart Praxi-Bot.

q: How do I change the language or the look?
a: Open Settings. Language and Appearance are on the first pages. You can pick light or dark colors and a background. The change applies right away.
